info.title: Inventory System API
info.description: Nigeria health supply-chain inventory API. Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

get.summary:
Alerts for every facility in the caller's scope, most severe first.
Without a status filter, returns alerts still needing attention
(open and acknowledged)

parameters.name: facility_id
parameters.description: Narrow to one facility within your scope.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Mark an open alert as seen and being handled. No-op if already acknowledged

Close an alert. If the stock situation still holds, it is not raised
again until it clears and recurs. No-op if already resolved

get.summary: The current user, their role, and the hierarchy node they are anchored at

Change your own password — required before anything else while on a

get.summary: A facility's delivery notes, newest first

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

post.summary:
Create a delivery note — a draft, or confirmed straight away with
confirm=true (the phone's reviewed scan). 201 when created; 200 with
the existing note when client_reference repeats one already sent
Post a draft's items to the ledger as receipts

received_date.description: When it actually arrived, if not the note's received_date (e.g. a dispatch from another store).

post.summary:
Register (or clear, with null) the push token of the device the user is
signed in on. Tokens rotate, so the app sends it on every sign-in and
foreground (mobile/CLAUDE.md rule 4)

token.description: FCM registration token; null to stop pushes to this user (e.g. on sign-out).

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Issue stock to a facility below this store. 201 with the receiver's
draft delivery note; 200 with the existing one when client_reference
repeats a dispatch already made

Computed live from stock_balances — fine at LGA scale, and it carries

LGA rollup: totals per product, how many facilities carry each flag,

facility_count.description: Same as child_count here; the facility total at State and Federal level.

facility_counts.description: Number of child facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

facility_status.description: Facilities by their most serious issue, each counted once.

Mark one read; already-read ones keep their first read time

get.summary: The product catalog. Not hierarchy-scoped: every role sees the same catalog

get.summary: Every active product, plus any retired one this facility set levels for, by name

delete.summary: Go back to the catalog's levels for this product

get.summary: Accounts the caller manages, by name

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Create an account on a temporary password (generated unless given), returned once

temporary_password.description: Give this to the person; they must change it at first sign-in. Not retrievable later.

put.summary: Change name, email, role / node, or deactivate (signs the account out everywhere)

post.summary: Set a new temporary password and sign the account out everywhere

temporary_password.description: Give this to the person; they must change it at their next sign-in.

condition_active.description: False once the stock situation that raised the alert has cleared.

resolved_by_name.description: Null when resolved automatically because the condition cleared.

AlertType.description: Same values as alerts.alert_type in docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md.
AlertType.title: AlertType

reporting_facility_count.description: Facilities with at least one product on the Stock Card.

flag_counts.description: Number of facilities with at least one product carrying each flag.

needs_reorder_count.description: Facilities with at least one product at or below reorder level.

stock_out_products.description: Products stocked out at the most facilities here, top 3.

category.description: What the action is about: stock, deliveries, accounts, catalog, facilities or alerts.

actor.description: Null when no person is known (history from before the log existed).

changes.description: Edits: { field: [before, after] }; creations: the values set.

source_facility.description: The store that dispatched it; null for deliveries from outside the system.

stock_transaction_id.description: The receipt this line became, once confirmed.

source_transaction_id.description: The issue on the sender's Stock Card, for a dispatch.

return_transaction_id.description: The receipt back onto the sender's card, if the receiver rejected it.

anyOf.description: Null for SDPs; otherwise which node's store this is.

lga.description: Null for state and national stores.

state.description: Null only for the national store.

last_transaction_date.description: Date of the facility's most recent Stock Card entry, if any.

flag_counts.description: Number of this facility's products carrying each flag.

needs_reorder_count.description: Products at or below reorder level (includes low stock and stock-outs).

flagged_products.description: Products with any flag or at/below reorder level.

FulfilReorderRequestRequest.description:
POST /reorder-requests/{reorderRequest}/fulfil: what the store actually
sends — a dispatch to the requester. Ledger rules (enough stock, known
unexpired batch, no back-dating) are checked as each line is issued.

voucher_no.description: Issue voucher / waybill number; DSP-000123 is generated when omitted.

batch_no.description: Required for batch-tracked products; a batch the store holds.

FulfilReorderRequestRequest.title: FulfilReorderRequestRequest

alert_id.description: The alert it is about (type "alert"); null for digests.

payload.description:
Named payload, not data: a resource with a "data" key isn't wrapped in one.
alert: { alert_id, alert_type, facility_id, url }; digest: { url, counts: { stock_out, expired,
low_stock, expiring_soon }, facility_count, since }.

pushed_at.description: Null when it wasn't pushed (no device registered, or the push failed).

pack_size.description: Pieces in each unit (pack, box, carton…); null for single-piece units.

created_by.description: Who added it (may edit it, as may admins); null for seeded products.

facility_counts.description: Number of facilities where this product carries each flag.

facilities_needing_reorder.description: Facilities where this product is at or below reorder level.

levels.description:
The min / EOP / max judged against here: this facility's own when set (`source: "facility"`),
else the catalog's (`source: "catalog"`). EOP < min ≤ max.

quantity_on_hand.description: Sum of stock_balances.quantity_on_hand across batches, including expired stock.

usable_quantity.description: On hand minus expired batches; thresholds are judged on this.

response_note.description: Why it was declined, or the note sent with the stock.

delivery_note.description: The dispatch that fulfilled it; `status` is the requester's (draft = not yet received).

amc_quantity.description: Average Monthly Consumption (issues per month); null without a complete month of history.

amc_months_used.description: Complete months the AMC is averaged over.

amc_period_month.description: Month of the AMC snapshot used (YYYY-MM-DD, first of month); null if none computed yet.

months_of_stock.description: Usable stock divided by AMC; null without an AMC.

max_stock_quantity.description: Target stock level: AMC x max months, or the product's max_stock_level without an AMC.

suggested_quantity.description: Max stock minus usable stock, never negative.

SaveFacilityRequest.description:
POST /facilities and PUT /facilities/{facility} (admin). SDPs only — the
LGA / State / National stores are created with their node and aren't
edited here. A facility stays in its LGA: its Stock Card history and
rollups belong there, so moving one means a new facility.

lga_id.description: Create only: the LGA it sits in.

is_active.description: false closes it: no new Stock Card entries, history kept.

SaveFacilityRequest.title: SaveFacilityRequest

SaveProductLevelsRequest.description: PUT /facilities/{facility}/product-levels/{product}: this facility's own min / EOP / max, EOP < min ≤ max.

reorder_level.description: This facility's Emergency Order Point: alerts and push notifications fire when usable stock reaches it.

SaveProductLevelsRequest.title: SaveProductLevelsRequest

SaveProductRequest.description:
POST /products (anyone signed in — every level may add products) and
PUT /products/{product} (admins, or whoever added it). On update every
field is optional. The catalog levels must read EOP < min ≤ max; each
facility may then set its own (PUT /facilities/{id}/product-levels/{product}).
Container units (pack, box, carton…) say how many pieces each holds.
Batch tracking can't be switched once the product has a Stock Card entry
anywhere, or old and new rows would disagree.

sku.description: Short product code, unique; upper-cased. Printed on delivery notes, so scanning matches on it.

unit_of_measure.description: What one counts as on the Stock Card.

pack_size.description: Pieces in each pack / box / carton / bag / kit — required for those units, optional otherwise.

reorder_level.description: The Emergency Order Point (EOP): below the minimum; alerts fire when usable stock reaches it.

is_active.description: false retires it: hidden from entry forms, history kept.

SaveProductRequest.title: SaveProductRequest

StockLevel.description: Where a product's *usable* (unexpired) quantity sits against its thresholds — the Bin Card's Min SL / EOP columns. The EOP (emergency order point) sits below the minimum.
StockLevel.title: StockLevel

client_reference.description: The client's idempotency key, if it sent one.

StoreDeliveryNoteRequest.description:
Shape validation for POST /facilities/{facility}/delivery-notes. Ledger
rules (known batch expiry, back-dating) are checked when the note is
confirmed, by StockLedgerService.

source.description: Supplier or warehouse; becomes the receipts' "Received from".

capture_method.description: "ocr" when the lines were read from a photo on the device and reviewed by staff.

confirm.description: Confirm straight away (post the receipts) instead of saving a draft.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key: re-sending it returns the note already created.

StoreDeliveryNoteRequest.title: StoreDeliveryNoteRequest

StoreDispatchRequest.description:
Shape validation for POST /facilities/{facility}/dispatches. Ledger rules
(enough stock, known and unexpired batch, no back-dating) are checked by
StockLedgerService as each line is issued.

destination_facility_id.description: A facility one level down the chain (GET /facilities/{facility}/dispatch-destinations).

voucher_no.description: Issue voucher / waybill number; DSP-000123 is generated when omitted.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key: re-sending it returns the dispatch already made.

batch_no.description: Required for batch-tracked products; must be a batch the store holds.

StoreDispatchRequest.title: StoreDispatchRequest

StoreLevel.description: Which hierarchy node a store facility belongs to. SDPs have none.
StoreLevel.title: StoreLevel

StoreReorderRequestRequest.description: POST /facilities/{facility}/reorder-requests: ask a store above for stock.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key: re-sending it returns the request already made.

StoreReorderRequestRequest.title: StoreReorderRequestRequest

StoreStockTransactionRequest.description:
Shape validation for POST /facilities/{facility}/stock-transactions.
State-dependent checks (unknown batch, insufficient stock, back-dating)
live in StockLedgerService and also come back as 422s.

client_reference.description: Idempotency key (e.g. a UUID from an offline outbox). Re-sending it returns the entry already recorded.

StoreStockTransactionRequest.title: StoreStockTransactionRequest

StoreUserRequest.description: POST /users — a new account on a temporary password.

facility_id.description: Required for sdp_staff: the facility (SDP) they work at.

temporary_password.description: Leave out to have one generated. Either way it must be changed at first sign-in.

StoreUserRequest.title: StoreUserRequest

TransactionType.description: Stock Card row types. quantity is always >= 0; the direction comes from the type. This is the single definition of how each type moves a balance — StockLedgerService and ReconcileStockBalances both go through apply().
TransactionType.title: TransactionType

UnitOfMeasure.description: The unit a product is counted in on the Stock Card — every quantity for that product is a number of these. Container units (pack, box, carton…) also record how many pieces each one holds (products.pack_size).
UnitOfMeasure.title: UnitOfMeasure

UpdateUserRequest.description: PUT /users/{user} — any subset of the fields; role and node are checked together.

is_active.description: false deactivates the account and signs it out everywhere; true reactivates it.

UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest

node.description: The hierarchy node this account is anchored at; drives which dashboard the client opens.

store.description: The store whose Stock Card an LGA / State / Federal officer keeps; null for SDP staff and admins.

must_change_password.description: Still on a temporary password: clients send the user to change it before anything else.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
